learning_outcomes.text: Explain synthetic biology as the engineering of biological systems
Describe the design-build-test-learn cycle in bioengineering
Explain genetic parts, circuits and the idea of standardisation conceptually
Describe common applications in medicine, materials and sustainability
Reason about biosafety, biosecurity and containment principles
Assess ethical, regulatory and societal considerations responsibly

integrative_case: A policy analyst reviews a synthetic-biology startup making a sustainable material: explain the design-build-test-learn approach, assess the realism of its claims, and ensure biosafety, biosecurity, containment and governance considerations are addressed responsibly. This course stays conceptual and does not provide laboratory protocols.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
